decisions.reason: Adding the NFT detail page as another ebook-viewer entry point does not change the certificate email's contents, read action, or download link.
The additional viewer entry point does not change the NFT-holder access policy, Lit Protocol gating, ownership verification, or content protection.
The viewer entry-point change does not affect the book's Pinata/IPFS storage location or takedown control.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY establishing the View Book action and its owner-only visibility on the NFT detail page.
The ebook viewer's NFT-detail entry point does not require any change to the current FAQ copy.
The source change does not alter automatic wallet creation, custody, wallet contents, or fiat-buyer dashboard access paths.
The message separately verifies the NFT cover sizing, but the source viewer-entry-point change does not modify the cover presentation requirement.
Adding an NFT-detail viewer entry point does not change the About page's technology, process, feature, or vision content.
The source does not change SIWE authentication or the existing Transak-wallet dashboard sign-in behavior.
The new ebook-viewer entry point does not change email authentication, eligible dashboard users, or authenticated dashboard areas.
The NFT-detail viewer entry point is unrelated to the landing-page hero's copy, layout, CTA, and visual emphasis.
The source change does not alter prize announcement, dashboard notification, email notification, or winner-guidance behavior.
